spec_match.rationale: Asks the three real capability surfaces — HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType(), MediaSource.isTypeSupported(), and mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo() for both media-source and file query types — with the same IAMF content type, and shows each literal return value.

interactive.rationale: Preset select, editable content-type field, and a run button; each door panel updates with the raw answer plus a plain-language meaning.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the same string through three front doors with literal return values; the page does exactly that including the MSE-doors-agree readout.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles missing MediaSource, missing mediaCapabilities, per-type decodingInfo rejection (TypeError for unparsable strings), and the legitimate MSE-yes/progressive-no divergence, each with its own honest text.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus, MSE spec isTypeSupported, and MDN canPlayType.

conformance.rationale: The v153 suite's iamf-mse-surfaces-agree and iamf-canplaytype-vocabulary assertions pin this page's core contracts; 9/9 pass in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): default preset answered canPlayType '', isTypeSupported false, decodingInfo(media-source).supported false, doors-agree true, honest not-decodable-yet line; console and network clean; screenshot v153-iamf-triptych.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts iamf-triptych-ran, iamf-triptych-mse-doors-agree (falsifiable — fails if the two MSE doors ever disagree), and iamf-triptych-fallback-no-mc on the missing-surface path.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; door outputs are dark text on --bg-stone with a border, meeting AA.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and text input, 44px controls, per-door output elements, and a single role=status aria-live=polite summary so three panels do not triple-announce.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Doors grid collapses to one column via auto-fit minmax(240px,1fr); responsive-check passes both classes with no horizontal overflow; screenshots judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Capture the MSE-yes/progressive-no divergence on a real IAMF build
openQuestions.detail: The page explains that a build decoding IAMF only via MSE may answer yes at the MSE doors and '' at canPlayType, but no available browser can demonstrate it yet. Once an IamfAudioDecoding-enabled build exists, record the actual three-door answers and confirm the explanation matches reality.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce async result status live region without stealing focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use one polite live region for the summary of a multi-part async result rather than making every output area live.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The three door outputs are aria-live=off; only the combined status line is role=status aria-live=polite.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: status line carried the full three-door summary after one click

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit minmax grids so panels reflow instead of overflowing on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: .doors uses repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and inputs are width:100% box-sizing:border-box.

summary: v153 refile of the v152 triptych with milestone framing updated to the shipping-stage story (anticipated 153, still Proposed). Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141: all three doors answered with their literal values, doors-agree true, honest negative wording, clean console/network, both responsive classes pass.
